title: Phase 2: User Type System - Unknown Workflow, Partner Agent, Message Router, Frontend Types, Seller LLM
goal: Implement the full 5-category contact classification system with AI-powered identification, partner agent handling, central message routing, and LLM-powered seller workflow.

sub_tasks.title: Unknown Identification Workflow
sub_tasks.output: Created workflows/unknown.ts with AI-powered contact type classification. Added classifyContactType() to LLM service. Added getIdentificationPrompt() to SystemPromptService.

sub_tasks.title: Partner Agent System
sub_tasks.output: Created workflows/partner_agent.ts with dual-mode handling (HAS_PROPERTIES/HAS_BUYERS). Added getPartnerAgentPrompt() to SystemPromptService. PartnerAgent model already in schema from Phase 1.

sub_tasks.title: Central Message Router
sub_tasks.output: Created services/message_router.ts with route() method. Refactored webhooks.ts to use MessageRouter instead of inline routing logic. Removed primitive keyword matching.

sub_tasks.title: Contact Type in Frontend
sub_tasks.output: Added contact_type badges to ContactList.tsx (color-coded by type). Added dropdown selector in ChatView.tsx for manual classification. Added PATCH /api/contacts/:phone endpoint. Added updateContactType() to API client.

sub_tasks.title: Seller Workflow LLM Upgrade
sub_tasks.output: Refactored seller.ts from hardcoded questions to LLM-powered flow using SystemPromptService.getSellerPrompt(). Maintains keyword extraction for property type but generates AI responses.

acceptance_criteria: Unknown contacts get AI-powered identification via Panditji
Partner agents have dedicated workflow with dual-mode handling
Central MessageRouter replaces inline webhook routing
Frontend shows contact_type badges and allows manual override
Seller workflow uses Gemini AI for conversational responses
result_summary: Phase 2 complete. All 5 contact types are now classified, routed, and displayed. The system flow is: New message → SSOT lookup → MessageRouter.route(contact_type) → Correct workflow → AI response → WhatsApp reply.
